usageLedgerNote: The app writes UsageLedger rows (aiGateway -> appendUsage) and AiCall records inside each run's throwaway in-memory database, which the frozen harness does not export. Reconciliation uses the app's recordAiCall records (logged with costUsd, same priceCatalog). Evaluator calls are made by the benchmark scripts directly and are not app traffic, so they have no app ledger rows; they are metered from SDK usage.
